title: compact handoff sentinel and shift-boundary telemetry compressor
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: on-call handoffs are noisy and repetitive: large alert lists and dense telemetry windows make readable handoffs hard to write and validate. This PR introduces two companion features: a lightweight 'Handoff Sentinel' that watches for incomplete handoff messages and suggests an enriched summary, and a 'Shift-Boundary Telemetry Compressor' that aggregates high-frequency signals across the shift boundary into a compact, human- and machine-friendly bundle. The goal is to reduce handoff friction, lower oncall cognitive load, and provide a deterministic, audit-friendly bundle that incident-bot and downstream tools can consume. Features: 1) CLI: `slo-toolkit handoff summarize --window 30m --compress-level medium` produces a compressed bundle plus suggested handoff notes. 2) Sentinel: a background check that validates handoff messages (presence of incident summary, pending actions, blockers) and attaches suggested content with recent alerts, top traces, and anomaly highlights. 3) Compressor: a configurable summarizer that turns dense metric/trace histograms into delta summaries, spike fingerprints, and compact traces (head-only snippets + links). 4) Integration hook: gRPC endpoint for incident-bot to request the compressed bundle when producing runbook drafts. 5) Config: runtime flags and Helm chart knobs for retention and compression level. Implementation notes: compressor uses a streaming reservoir + top-k spike detector tuned for 1s-1h signals, configurable by workload; sentinel is non-blocking and returns an enrichment suggestion object rather than mutating handoff text. Checklist: - [x] Implementation for CLI + library (pkg/handoff) - [x] Unit tests and benchmarks for compressor - [x] Integration test that simulates shift boundary handoff - [x] Docs and handbook page under docs/handbook/oncall/handoff.md - [x] Helm chart defaults and feature flag - [x] Performance review and memory cap (see review thread) Compatibility and risk: default compressor settings are conservative; feature is opt-in via helm flag `handoff.enabled` and CLI flag for summarize. No breaking changes to public APIs. Related: ENG-3421 (handoff UX improvement), ENG-4110 (telemetry budget savings).

ci_checks: benchmarks: added compressor microbench; median 12ms per 1k points
release_notes: Add a compact handoff sentinel and telemetry compressor: opt-in helm flag `handoff.enabled`. CLI `slo-toolkit handoff summarize` to produce compressed handoff bundles; background sentinel suggests handoff enrichments. Helpful for reducing handoff noise and shrinking oncall context size.
notes_for_ops: Default helm settings are conservative; disable or tune `compressor.memory_cap_mb` for constrained clusters. The sentinel is non-blocking and will not mutate handoff text unless operator accepts suggestion in the UI or CLI. gRPC endpoint requires TLS and token auth (see charts and docs).
migration_instructions: No migration required. To enable: set `handoff.enabled=true` in helm values and redeploy slo-toolkit. For incident-bot integration, update incident-bot config with the new gRPC endpoint and credentials (see docs).
changelog_excerpt: Feature: packed handoff bundles + sentinel-driven handoff enrichment (opt-in). Improved shift-boundary telemetry summarization reduces handoff noise.
